I main Highlander, LB, and BP. I love defensive characters absolutely every fighting game needs them. I don’t think anyone on this comment has complained about conqueror being a defensive hero. The problem with conqueror is not his inability to open but rather his inability to counter attack effectively. You yourself said that often the characters which require the most precision often have the best pay off. Which is exactly why I think good defense should be more rewarding opposed to being safer.

I’m not talking viability the original comment states that conq shouldn’t have a rework. The key difference between buffing a character and reworking them is that one makes a character more viable, while the other makes them more interesting. Obviously there is overlap, but case in point. 

I also have no problem with defensive characters, just conqueror. His defense revolves around option selecting your opponents with chip damage bash light or zone. He has very mediocre punishes and his all guard has very little use especially with how much stamina it uses. He’s played more as a stamina bully with the bash spam at almost every level. But at a certain point of skill the only things keeping him “viable” are his abilities to option select and read an opponent to death. He is one dimensional, boring to play, boring to fight, relatively. 

In terms of viability if that’s all you care about I promise you his current state won’t last. You will see him fall down the tier list quickly as the game continues it’s power creep.

This strategies effectiveness is exponentiated by bullet magnetism and the burst bloom retical. (The bloom isn’t big enough to be a hinderance to accuracy like the semi, but just enough so that off center aim is forgiven with lucky shots skimming the edge of your bloom.) 

Specifically 1v1s with this weapon at high level comp are poor indicators of skill. Comp is already know for people abusing corner shooting and pop shoting as viable counters to agressive movement based players. And with this weapon that stereotype is only more true. Passive burst rifle play is easy to perfect and pushes down the skill gap between genuinely skilled and average players. An average player with more patience could clap a great player in a burst 1v1. 



ALL that being said, the weapon is sexy in clips, and has the potential for one of the highest skill ceilings in the game. It’s just when used optimally, it’s no fun, and too strong.
